description_en: You can invoke CreateCustomCallTagging to create one or more inbound number tags under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用CreateCustomCallTagging在指定实例下创建一个或多个呼入号码标记
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-custom-call-tagging --instance-id ccc-test --custom-number-list 'number_:_13121210000_,_description_:_王先生_,_callTagNameList_:_TagA_,_number_:_13888880000_,_description_:_张先生_,_callTagNameList_:_TagB' --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomCallTagging

parameters.help_en: A list of inbound control tags, formatted as a JSON array string. The number of array elements must be between 1 and 10,000. Each element in the array is an object with the following properties: number (must be a numeric string of 4 to 32 characters), description, and callTagNameList. The callTagNameList is an array whose elements are number labels (ensure that these number labels have already been created)
parameters.help_zh: 呼入控制标记列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，要求数组元素个数范围为1-10000。数组的元素是一个对象，包括以下属性：number（格式要求为4-32位的数字）、description、callTagNameList，其中callTagNameList是一个数组，元素是号码标签，（确保号码标签是已创建的号码标签）
parameters.name: custom_number_list

Data.description_en: The list of inbound number tags that failed to be created
Data.description_zh: 创建失败的呼入号码标记列表

items.description_en: Information about an inbound number tag that failed to be created
items.description_zh: 创建失败的呼入号码标记信息

Item.description_en: The number of the inbound number tag that failed to be created
Item.description_zh: 创建失败的呼入号码标记的号码

Reason.description_en: The reason why the creation of the inbound number tag failed
Reason.description_zh: 呼入号码标记创建失败原因
